explanation: The theorem is about the free pro-2 group on n generators. It says that any two nondegenerate non-alternating degree-one forms are related by a continuous automorphism of that group. Mathlib has no freeProP, Demushkin or graded-piece development, so there is nothing to match. I searched Mathlib for freeProP and Demushkin and found no occurrences. The only general ingredient is the classification of symmetric bilinear forms by equivalence (`equivalent_of_finrank_eq`). The proof uses that lemma together with library-specific lifting lemmas, so the theorem is not a short instantiation of any single Mathlib declaration.
